tasks.title: Reconcile the real checkout and install this handoff

Reconcile any existing AGENTS.md without replacing it; initialize STATUS.md, NEXT_SESSION.md and the first session record.
Commit the handoff only, push the feature branch, check live matching refs, and open or update one draft PR when tooling is available.
